figs.cap: a) The mean-field model sums over the thermal ensemble of spins in a nanomagnetic domain and represents their average moment as a single variable between -1 and 1, mᵢ(t). b) An illustration of a tree of coupled nanomagnets. c) The square lattice, a two-dimensional model system for frustrated magnetism. In the nearest neighbor approximation, nanomagnets sharing a vertex interact with one another. d) A unit cell of the diamond lattice, a three-dimensional system where interaction occurs between tetrapod-sharing nanomagnets.
The power spectra P(f) for R=10 plotted as the external field h^* is varied for a ( a ) chain of flips and ( b ) a Cayley tree with d=3.

The fractal dimension of the field reversal clusters at a) β=2000 and b) β=200 plotted against interaction strength ratio J₁/J₂ and scaled field h^*.
